title: Open-source DWG container verifier admission and evidence ceiling
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan-readiness refinement

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was already broadly modified and uncommitted. This research pass edited only DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md and created this receipt; no prior or unrelated work was staged or committed.

sources.observation: The project describes a detect-only 0.1.0 checker for AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032. Tier 1 performs ODA-spec-chapter-4-derived container checks, but does not parse objects or verify per-object CRCs, handle-map CRCs, or Header/Classes CRCs. Tier 2 converts through ODA File Converter and then uses ezdxf.recover, reporting its recovery errors/fixes separately. Its reported fixture set comes from LibreDWG's test corpus and its metrics were not independently reproduced here.
sources.limitations: The repository page showed no release and no exact source SHA was resolved. The README reports that ODA 27.9 Tier 2 was verified on macOS ARM64; Linux and Windows paths are untested. It documents misses for Preview/RevHistory/FileDepList damage and trailing bytes, and no ODA audit fix count. These statements remain project-reported.
sources.planDisposition: Candidate structural detector only at the existing composed checkpoint, conditional on exact source/environment pinning. Do not treat its status as entity semantics, support, or native acceptance. AC1018 is explicitly unsupported by this checker and must stay outside its denominator.

sources.observation: The current NEWS and fuzzing guidance describe separate DWG/DXF decode/encode and malformed-input failure classes, which corroborate the need to keep container checks separate from parser, writer, object-graph, and semantic evidence.
sources.planDisposition: Reuse existing local hardening owners and planned composed fuzz/sanitizer checkpoint; no duplicate tests or peer-derived limits.

sources.observation: The current issue index still lists previously researched codepage, VERTEX, recursive-input, EED-size, nested-block-copy, and ACIS writer failure shapes.
sources.planDisposition: All are already mapped to existing owners. No new local reproduction, finding, or duplicate test was added.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-06/PAR-14/PAR-26: preserve route-specific container, parser, writer, and hardening evidence
PAR-07/S8 and composed output checkpoint: optional exact-pinned structural detector with recovery separated
Existing ACadSharp issue-to-owner map: no duplicate peer-title tests

sequence: Continue dependency-ready local implementation; no code path waits for this peer tool.
At the composed checkpoint only, require exact checker source SHA, Python/lockfile, ODA binary version, and scratch input/output hashes before an optional run.
Limit any structural run to locally generated AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 files; record AC1018 as unsupported by this tool.
Report container checks, ODA conversion, and ezdxf recovery errors/fixes separately; never equate T1/T2 status with entity semantics or native acceptance.
Use only locally generated scratch mutations for the peer's corruption classes; do not import/commit its LibreDWG fixtures or copy reported rates as acceptance criteria.
After each implementation item, update plan/receipt, run the owning fast selector, report progress after commit, and self-unblock to the next ready local item.
implementationReadiness.supportBoundary: No checker status, ODA conversion, recovery-parser pass, peer issue, or container check promotes DWG/DXF entity, graph, ACIS, B-rep, FreeCAD, platform, or J-item support.

limitations: Primary-source pages and repository documentation were reviewed via web search. No exact dwg-verifier commit was resolved or executed; no peer source, ODA File Converter, native CAD application, or external drawing was run or downloaded. No local code/test/fixture/dependency changed. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
